# libredwg-web 0.8.3

Reads DWG files in the browser (used by js/dwgplan.js to import a survey plan).

- Source: https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web (npm `@mlightcad/libredwg-web` 0.8.3)
- Built from GNU LibreDWG: https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0). Full text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

The files in this folder are the unmodified `dist/libredwg-web.js`, `wasm/libredwg-web.js` and `wasm/libredwg-web.wasm` from that package.
